rationale: The commit changed the 10% tier boundary from 'qty >= 10' to 'qty > 10'. This is an off-by-one: exactly 10 units no longer earns the 10% discount, so total([(10.0, 10)]) returns 100.0 instead of 90.0. The fix restores the inclusive boundary.
diff:
--- a/demo/pricing.py
+++ b/demo/pricing.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ def bulk_discount_rate(qty):
     """Discount rate for a line quantity: 15% at 100+, 10% at 10+, else 0."""
     if qty >= 100:
         return 0.15
-    if qty > 10:  # BUG: off-by-one, should be >= 10
+    if qty >= 10:
         return 0.10
     return 0.0
